summary: Every authority decision made from the candidate's changed-path set uses one machine-safe Git-owned ChangeSet, or is reconciled against it and refuses on disagreement: a path Git quotes must never be invisible to confinement.
plan: Add an authoritative changed-path source in internal/gitx/git.go: a ChangeSet type holding FileChange{Path, OldPath, Status} produced from `git diff --no-ext-diff --name-status -z` against the pinned base, parsed on NUL boundaries so no pathname Git can produce is lost or split, with both sides of a rename preserved and a deterministic order after parsing. In internal/workflow/engine.go, obtain that ChangeSet for the candidate and reconcile it against report.FromDiff(diff) at BOTH existing binding points -- the one immediately after the read-only (ModeInspect) refusal over the worker's diff, and the one immediately after e.validate returns over the diff validation re-read -- comparing the set of paths, each status, and rename old paths; if the two disagree in any of those, refuse the candidate the way the ModeInspect refusal does, naming the disagreement, before validation, the prospective inspection, the test-edit inspection, the audit, the Level-1 classification, the review or admission sees it. Confinement takes its paths from the authoritative ChangeSet rather than re-parsing the diff: change confineToPlan in internal/workflow/testedit.go to accept the changed paths (including rename old paths) and the plan's named files, canonicalising with path.Clean(strings.TrimSpace(f)) exactly as architecturalFiles does, refusing and naming every path outside the plan; it must not take or read test-edit grants. Repair internal/report/report.go so FromDiff parses Git-quoted headers ("a/…" and "b/…" with C-style escapes) and reports those files, because a report that silently drops a file is wrong regardless -- but it remains a renderer and never the source of pathname authority. Tests in internal/gitx/git_test.go: a non-ASCII path, a path containing a tab, a rename with a quoted old path and one with a quoted new path, a deletion of a quoted path, and an ordinary ASCII control, each appearing in ChangeSet with the right status and both rename sides. Tests in internal/report/report_test.go: FromDiff reports quoted and escaped paths, and the ASCII control still parses. Tests in internal/workflow/engine_test.go: a quoted out-of-plan modification is refused; a quoted out-of-plan deletion is refused; a rename whose old path is outside the plan is refused; a disagreement between report.FromDiff and the authoritative ChangeSet refuses before any downstream consumer; the ordinary in-plan candidate still passes; and confinement still refuses at both binding points, including a formatter that widens the candidate during validation. No other behaviour changes; no signature changes beyond confineToPlan's parameters; no new files.
steps: Add ChangeSet, FileChange and Status to internal/gitx/git.go, produced from `git diff --no-ext-diff --name-status -z` against the pinned base and parsed on NUL boundaries.
Change confineToPlan in internal/workflow/testedit.go to take changed paths (rename old paths included) and the plan's named files, with no grant input.

In runCandidate in internal/workflow/engine.go, obtain the authoritative ChangeSet, reconcile it against report.FromDiff at both existing binding points, refuse on any disagreement, and pass the authoritative paths to confineToPlan.
Repair report.FromDiff in internal/report/report.go to parse Git-quoted and escaped path headers, keeping it a renderer rather than an authority.
Add the tests named in the plan to internal/gitx/git_test.go, internal/report/report_test.go and internal/workflow/engine_test.go.
Run gofmt -l cmd internal, go vet ./..., and go test ./... .
consequences: A candidate that changes a path Git quotes can no longer be invisible to confinement, and any disagreement between the textual patch and Git's own path list refuses the candidate before any authority decision is taken. Candidates whose paths are ordinary and inside their plan behave exactly as before. This does not change the artifact boundary in internal/gitx/capture.go, whose --numstat pathname parsing is out of scope.

claims.statement: report.FromDiff recognises only unquoted `diff --git a/P b/P` and `+++ b/P` headers, so a Git-quoted path yields no FileChange and confineToPlan sees nothing outside the plan.
report.FromDiff feeds changedPaths, diffFileStates, inspectProspectiveSurfaces, CandidateShape and the change report, all inside runCandidate and all downstream of the same diff.
internal/gitx already runs `git diff --no-ext-diff` and a --numstat variant against the pinned base, so a NUL-delimited name-status variant is available to the same caller.
